name: @metorial/ynab
description: Read YNAB budgets, accounts, transactions, categories, payees, and monthly summaries. Create supported accounts and payees, manage transaction and category metadata, schedule recurring transactions, and import linked-bank transactions. Use integer milliunits for monetary values and server knowledge for delta sync. Existing split parts must be edited in the YNAB app; account, category, group, and payee records cannot be deleted through the API.
